digest.component_or_area: CI lint and store write seams
propositions: Production bugs arose from store write paths bypassing canonical write seams by issuing raw git add/commit/rm operations outside the locked transaction and reconciler layers.

A two-layer deterministic CI lint must flag raw git mutations in Python (via AST, module-agnostic) and in workflows/shell (cwd-aware within tracker context), with sanction via inline `# raw-git-ok: <reason>` markers requiring a mandatory reason.

The lint detects mutation verbs (add/commit/rm/reset/update-ref) via intra-function local variable tracking (literals, splat expansion) and fail-closed opaque argv forwarding to wrapper names, while legitimate seam internals and sandbox repos receive markers documenting their rationale.
A report-mode bootstrap scan inventories all current hits; every hit must be remediated or reasoned-marked before enforcement wires, ensuring the tree is clean at landing.
The lint teaches that store writes must route through event-append/transaction APIs or the reconciler git_adapter, making the canonical write seams statically enforceable.
